proposal.summary: Avaya IP Office web interface embeds Base64-encoded credentials in URLs and WebSocket query strings, disclosing administrator credentials (Administrator:Administrator) which can be leaked via browser history, logs, referer headers, proxies, etc.
proposal.cwe_quote: pass Base64 encoded credentials as part of the URL query string.

AC.quote: The Base64 encoded credentials can be easily disclosed if the machine used to logon to the web Manager is accessed by an attacker.

PR.quote: pass Base64 encoded credentials as part of the URL query string.

UI.quote: pass Base64 encoded credentials as part of the URL query string.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the presence of credentials in URLs/WebSocket queries on affected systems, rotate any exposed credentials (especially Administrator), and apply the vendor advisory/patch. Ensure credentials are not embedded in URLs and use secure authentication tokens or POST-based authentication.

evidence_quotes.claim: Credentials are passed in URL query string
evidence_quotes.quote: The request URL on port 7071 and the web socket component requests on port 7070 used by Atmosphere-Framework within Avaya IP Office, pass Base64 encoded credentials as part of the URL query string.
